title: Find the First Match
prompt: Write first_long(words, n) returning the FIRST word longer than n characters, or None if there is none.

tests.name: first match or None
tests.code:
assert first_long(["a", "bb", "cccc", "dd"], 2) == "cccc", "first over 2 chars"
assert first_long(["a", "b"], 99) is None, "no match -> None"
assert first_long([], 1) is None, "empty list -> None"
tests.hint: loop; return early on the first hit; after the loop, return None.
